headerDisplay: Configure your Tapo smart devices with an easy-to-use interface. This plugin supports automatic device discovery and encrypted credential storage, plus optional Secret Request for credential-free operation.
footerDisplay: For support and documentation, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/stoyanov-x/homebridge-tapo-stoyanov).

credentialType.title: Credential Type
credentialType.description: How to provide Tapo credentials: Traditional stores encrypted credentials on disk, Secret Request delivers them via iPhone push notification

email.title: TP-Link Account Email
email.description: Your TP-Link/Tapo account email address (encrypted) - Required for Traditional mode only

password.title: TP-Link Account Password
password.description: Your TP-Link/Tapo account password (encrypted) - Required for Traditional mode only

isEncrypted.title: Credentials Encrypted
isEncrypted.description: Whether credentials are encrypted (managed automatically by UI)

secretName.title: Secret Name
secretName.description: Name of the secret stored in iOS Keychain (e.g., 'tapo-credentials') - Required for Secret Request mode

secretServerUrl.title: Secret Request Server URL
secretServerUrl.description: URL of the secret-request server - Required for Secret Request mode

secretTimeout.title: Secret Request Timeout (seconds)
secretTimeout.description: How long to wait for secret approval on iPhone (1-48 hours)

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: Local IP address of the device

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll devices for status updates (10-300 seconds)
